acceptanceCriteria: The hazard is confirmed or refuted with a reproduction or a code-level argument retained in the ticket.
If confirmed, each legacy caller either moves to the owner that signals before reap or is recorded as an accepted limitation.
No legacy command changes from working to refused on any platform without an owner decision.
body:
Suspected defect, not confirmed by a reproduction. Recorded 2026-10-01 from the S0E native repair plan review: the legacy runner path signals the numeric process group after the leader has been reaped (internal/cem/gitrun/gitrun_unix.go killGroup), so the group ID can in principle be reused by an unrelated group before the signal. The S0E work adds a separate owner that keeps the leader unreaped while signalling and applies to Stable callers only; groupreap.Wait/Run are unchanged for the other callers (taskman, releasegate, testrunner, gokernel, criterionexperiment, doccompiler, liveverify) and for legacy CEM gitrun callers.

Expected: no numeric group signal after the leader is reaped. Actual (by code reading at 1e71d5f5, not observed at runtime): the legacy path can signal after reap.

2026-10-02 renewed CEM availability readback confirms the hazard by code-level ordering at composed source fa9c4167f02b65a1c315765a6ac550aabc899fd6: internal/groupreap/groupreap_unix.go Wait calls command.Wait at line22 then signalGroup(-processID,SIGKILL) at23 after leaderUnreaped error; both branches ignore real signal errors. ECHILD/observation failure never confers kill authority, and a collected numeric identity may be reused. No destructive PID-reuse reproduction is necessary or performed to establish this call ordering; actual foreign-process harm remains NOT_OBSERVED. Root dispatcher independent GateA requires qualified legacy helper before adoption. Current new V1-0667/0668 repair admits only Owner lifecycle/Stable paths and does NOT fix Wait/Run or legacy CEM killGroup paths; no blanket groupreap package qualification. Need separate bounded plan+GateA and exact legacy Wait/error/cancellation/output-join source scope before edits, with one Cmd.Wait/no post-reap real signal and meaningful cleanup failure disposition. Preserve the criterion requiring owner decision before currently working legacy platforms become refused. Native root reservation120 has exact Owner files, not groupreap_unix.go; full declared parent effects remain, no hidden widening or duplicate helper builder. See legacy-groupreap-impact.json and LEGACY-DEPENDENCY-PROPOSAL.md in the task control evidence.
title: Legacy groupreap Wait fallback signals a collected process group and suppresses cleanup errors
